calculation.expression: -(close/close.shift(5)-1)/rolling_std(pct_change(close),20), activated when cross-sectional std(5d returns) exceeds its trailing 60d median; otherwise missing
calculation.description: Ranks tradable cross-asset instruments for mean reversion after unusually dispersed five-day moves, scaling the reversal by recent realized volatility. The signal is computed only with completed historical prices and is intended for a 10-trading-day forward horizon.

validation.regime_notes: The high-dispersion gate was active on 49.27% of dates. Ten-day IC/ICIR were 0.110754/0.426344 across 64 usable dates in 2025-2026 and 0.028326/0.098346 across 237 dates in 2027-2028. The latest 2027-12-01 through 2028-11-29 subset remained positive at 0.013398/0.047086 but is below the ICIR gate, so recency risk is noted.
